text: {"name":"wlan_arp_rx_process","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Recognizes an ARP packet in an 802.11 SNAP frame, logs request and reply traffic, and dispatches requests targeting the interface's IPv4 address.","subsystem":"wlan","var_renames":{"v5":"frame_control_flags","v6":"frame_data_offset","v7":"adjusted_frame","v10":"arp_opcode_high","v12":"arp_opcode","v13":"target_ip"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":30,"meaning":"First byte of the SNAP EtherType; paired with offset 31, 0x08 0x06 identifies ARP."},{"offset":31,"meaning":"Second byte of the SNAP EtherType."},{"offset":38,"meaning":"High byte of the ARP opcode."},{"offset":39,"meaning":"Low byte of the ARP opcode; 1 is request and 2 is reply."},{"offset":40,"meaning":"ARP sender hardware address, passed to the request handler."},{"offset":56,"meaning":"Start of the four-byte ARP target protocol address (IPv4)."}]}
